entries.source: For ChaptarrNG 0.9.941+, create a separate random service key, set {variable} to that value on the ChaptarrNG container, then recreate the container and paste the same value here. Use two underscores between CHAPTARR, AUTH, and SEERRAPIKEY. This restricted key is different from the administrator API key shown under Settings > General > Security > API Key. Older ChaptarrNG and existing BookshelfNG connections can keep their current key. No variable is needed on SeerrNG.
entries.previousTranslation: Encontre a chave no ChaptarrNG em Configurações > Geral > Segurança > Chave da API. No ChaptarrNG 0.9.941 ou posterior, defina CHAPTARR__AUTH__SEERRAPIKEY no contêiner do ChaptarrNG e use aqui essa chave exclusiva do SeerrNG para limitar o acesso às operações do serviço de livros. Durante a migração, as conexões existentes do BookshelfNG mantêm a chave atual.
